title: Adventure Awaits in Vermont: The 2026 Thrill-Seeker's Guide
metaDescription: Push your limits in Vermont. From extreme sports to wilderness expeditions, this guide covers the best adventure experiences.
excerpt: For adrenaline junkies and outdoor enthusiasts, Vermont is a playground of epic proportions. This guide reveals the most thrilling adventures waiting for you.
author: Wanderlust Team
content:
Few places in the world can match the allure of Vermont. Whether you are seeking adventure in Vermont for the first time or returning for more, there is always something new to discover.

## Extreme Sports

- Skydiving and paragliding over Vermont's stunning landscapes
- White-water rafting on raging rivers that cut through Vermont
- Rock climbing and bouldering on world-class routes
- Bungee jumping from iconic bridges and platforms

![Adventure in Vermont](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1601189992152-6ef7ebb531a8?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Wilderness Expeditions

Caving expeditions reveal hidden underground worlds beneath Vermont that few travelers ever see.

## Water Adventures

- Scuba diving in crystal-clear waters with vibrant marine life
- Surfing legendary breaks that attract pros from around the world
- Kayaking through dramatic fjords and along rugged coastlines
- Snorkeling over coral reefs teeming with colorful fish
